scope: Normative requirements and scenarios only, not implementation acceptance

originalFindings.reason: Normative all-surface semantics now includes names, roles, states, values, relationships and supported actions. Nine named AT surface fixtures require semantic-oracle comparison and fail missing/unnamed controls.

UI-007/UI-010 make accessible outcome feedback identity-correlated, deduplicated and non-focus-stealing. Notification expectations now explicitly depend on frozen policy; named DND, irrelevant expiration and opt-in urgency cases reconcile scenarios with INTERACTION.md.

Native and accessibility focus restoration now covers identity-bound opener, surviving parent scope and declared MRU/desktop fallback; replacement incarnations are rejected and lock overrides restoration. Named opener closure, workspace, minimize, restart and address-reuse cases are present.

UI-012 covers native IME key consumption, field/composition identity, candidate geometry and late invalidated callbacks. Valid explicit commit now writes exactly once; cancellation/invalidation writes zero. Named explicit-valid-commit and invalidated-zero-commit cases remove the prior contradictory generic outcome.

P0 freezes measurable contrast, focus/target geometry and text-enlargement/reflow thresholds before host qualification; non-color cues and small-output/long-label fixtures are required. Numeric values remain a properly declared future qualification gate, not claimed measured success.

System preference versus explicit versioned override is declared; live changes settle at the next valid presentation opportunity while preserving target/focus/deadline/ownership. Minimize, restore, switcher and Task View fixtures exist; disabling reduced motion cannot replay completed motion.

summary: All six original accessibility findings confirmed closed at the requirements level. No remaining contradiction identified in the reviewed accessibility contracts. Numeric fixture targets, selected-host AT evidence and actual usability remain future implementation qualification gates.

remainingFindings.counterexample: INTERACTION.md says announcements honor do-not-disturb and expiration/action refusal only announce when relevant to a focused or user-invoked notification. UI-010 notification-arrival and notification-expiration scenarios require one message regardless of these states. A correct suppressed announcement can fail the written fixture.
remainingFindings.correction: Make normative announcement publication subject to frozen policy. Split arrival into ordinary polite announcement, DND-suppressed arrival and explicitly opted-in urgency. Split expiration into relevant focused/user-invoked announcement and irrelevant expiration with no unsolicited speech. No focus moves in any case; identity-correlated inspectable status may remain distinct from unsolicited speech.

remainingFindings.counterexample: Host restart, field recreation or focus loss invalidates composition and may legitimately yield zero committed text, but every UI-012 scenario currently says only the current generation commits once. The wording can be interpreted as requiring an unintended commit on an invalidation path.
remainingFindings.correction: Use explicit outcomes: valid selected commit writes exactly once; Escape cancellation, focus-loss cancellation, field retirement and restart write zero text and reject late callbacks; output/caret relocation preserves current composition until an explicit subsequent commit/cancel. Give consumed Enter/Escape/arrows separate named assertions.
